title: The Pieri box-shift as a non-commutative Fourier single-step shift
html: Under the non-commutative Fourier transform, multiplying by an element of the next Hecke algebra moves the Young-diagram support up the Young lattice by exactly one box, analogous to a single-step translation on the commutative frequency lattice. For two-row partitions, read as \mathrm{SU}_q(2) spins j = (\lambda_1 - \lambda_2)/2, the two possible added boxes raise or lower the spin by 1/2. In both cases a box is added; neither case removes one.
